parsed.faithful: SWIVELS, a kind of ring made to turn round in a ftafle, or other ring. Thefe are ufed when a fhip lies at her moorings; alfo in tedders for cattle, that they may turn round without unwarping the tedder.
parsed.modern: SWIVELS, a kind of ring made to turn round in a staple, or other ring. These are used when a ship lies at her moorings; also in tedders for cattle, that they may turn round without unwarping the tedder.
